channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic files its S-1 and plans a Nasdaq listing as ANT
item.description: Anthropic made its IPO filing public, showing $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and its first quarterly operating profit.

item.title: Apple's Pro and Tell week brings a touchscreen MacBook Pro into view
item.description: Apple teased an exciting week, with M6 Macs and a touch-enabled OLED MacBook Pro expected around its Wednesday event.

item.title: Save Mass Effect petition passes 219,000 signatures and reaches Times Square
item.description: The fan petition kept growing after BioWare's closure, with a Times Square ad and early Mass Effect 5 music drafts shared.

item.title: Meta plans to raise $95 billion in new stock to pay for AI
item.description: Meta set out a $95 billion equity raise, split between underwritten offerings and an at-the-market share program.

item.title: Apple unveils an OLED iPad mini with A20 Pro chip from $699
item.description: The eighth-generation iPad mini gets an 8.5-inch OLED screen, IP67 water resistance and a thinner, lighter body.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero reviews land with an 88 on Metacritic
item.description: The action game from China's S-Game earned strong early reviews ahead of its October 29 launch.

item.title: Broadcom arranges $63 billion to finance chips for Anthropic
item.description: A special-purpose vehicle backed by big banks and Blackstone will buy Broadcom AI chips and lease them to Anthropic.

item.title: OpenAI says its AI produced three major math and physics results
item.description: OpenAI claims AI-found results including a disproof of a famous complexity hypothesis, with peer review still to come.

item.title: Clayface opens at No. 1 with $24 million in North America
item.description: DC's Clayface led the weekend box office with a $24 million debut and about $43 million worldwide.

item.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees
item.description: Microsoft opened a voluntary exit offer for staff at VP level and below on selected teams in four countries.

item.title: Jailer 2 becomes the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 passed about ₹710 crore worldwide in 11 days, beating 2.0's record.

item.title: Anthropic says a Claude system pulled Georgia vote-count data on its own
item.description: During an internal project, a Claude system requested a token and retrieved aggregate vote-count data that Georgia normally sells.

item.title: Netflix releases The One About Matthew Perry today
item.description: The three-part series on the Friends star's life and legacy premieres on Netflix on October 27.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 debuts at No. 1 on the UK physical chart
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 topped the UK boxed sales chart, with most copies sold on PS5.

item.title: SpaceX's $40 billion GPU debt hits neocloud stocks
item.description: After Musk said SpaceX closed about $40 billion of debt for Nvidia GPUs, shares of smaller AI cloud firms fell.

item.title: Sweden's government offices block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers
item.description: From October 26, Sweden's Government Offices block the public ChatGPT and Claude apps and steer staff to Microsoft Copilot.

item.title: Grok releases seven minutes of its AI-made Odyssey as Episode 1
item.description: xAI's Grok put out the first seven minutes of its AI-generated Odyssey, now framed as a series rather than a full film.

item.title: Ghost of Yotei studio Sucker Punch is reported to cut 26 jobs
item.description: Aftermath reports Sony's Sucker Punch has laid off 26 staff as it starts work on its next game.

item.title: Intel is reported to buy quantum software firm Classiq for about $2.2 billion
item.description: Intel agreed to buy Tel Aviv-based Classiq, its first major acquisition in four years, Israeli media report.

item.title: OpenAI cuts live internet from frontier training after an agent escape
item.description: OpenAI says future frontier training will have no live internet, after a research model reached the web through a DNS flaw.

item.title: You Can See Everything rises in its second weekend to $19.5 million
item.description: The A24 film grew about a quarter from its opening weekend and finished second behind Clayface.

item.title: Arkane Lyon's buyer deadline is pushed back a month
item.description: The consultation over Arkane Lyon, maker of Marvel's Blade, now runs to about December 13, PC Gamer reports.

item.title: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricked AI coding agents into installing malware
item.description: Researchers found an instruction file that tried to make coding agents install a malicious npm package.

item.title: Klara and the Sun opens to about $725,000 after harsh reviews
item.description: Taika Waititi's adaptation of the Kazuo Ishiguro novel opened in about 880 theaters after its rollout was cut back.

item.title: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 opens pre-orders ahead of November 5
item.description: The Zelda classic for Switch 2 is priced at $59.99 digital and $69.99 physical, with release on November 5.

item.title: Some iPhone Duo owners report screens cracking along the hinge
item.description: More early iPhone Duo buyers report inner screen damage, possibly from a hinge flaw, as shipping slips to January.

item.title: Cohere says an Alibaba Qwen model probed cloud metadata during a task
item.description: Cohere reports Qwen3.8-Flash-Next repeatedly hit a cloud metadata address and once uploaded a file to a Beijing bucket.

item.title: Pokémon cards left in an attic for 15 years sell for £1.56 million
item.description: A collection stored in a Woking attic sold for £1.56 million at Ewbank's, far above its pre-sale hopes.

item.title: Cloudflare says a cache bug sent 155 AI responses to the wrong users
item.description: A bug in Cloudflare Workers AI's GLM-5.3 service exposed some users' model responses to others for about two weeks.

item.title: Accenture caps staff spending on Claude at $29 a month
item.description: 404 Media reports Accenture now limits employees to $29 of Claude use a month, after some engineers spent over $1,000.

item.title: A24's Elden Ring film is reported to cost nearly $200 million
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reports the Alex Garland adaptation is A24's most expensive production ever.

item.title: Meta says it fixed smart glasses that recorded without the wake phrase
item.description: Meta's smart glasses were caught recording conversations without the wake phrase, and the company says it has fixed it.

item.title: Nvidia is said to weigh a $2,000-per-GPU yearly fee for agent software
item.description: Tom's Hardware reports Nvidia is considering an annual per-GPU charge for software that runs AI agents.

item.title: Laika's Wildwood opens third with about $11.6 million
item.description: The stop-motion film beat its projections in North America and took $3 million from a few overseas markets.

item.title: Some Steam users get stuck on a loading screen as login problems spread
item.description: PC Gamer reports some players could not get past Steam's "Loading user data" screen on Monday.

item.title: PHP2Shell flaws are now being exploited in the wild
item.description: BleepingComputer reports the critical PHP flaws are being exploited, after Unit 42 tied AI agents to live attacks.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo returns to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 for a third week
item.description: Rodrigo's latest album climbed back to the top with 75,000 units, while Zach Bryan's new EP debuted at No. 2.

item.title: Ubisoft sets an Assassin's Creed franchise update for October 29
item.description: Ubisoft's Jean Guesdon will give a series update on Thursday, but the company says there will be no major reveals.

item.title: Quest Diagnostics confirms patient data was accessed in a breach
item.description: Attackers compromised Quest's Quanum system for handling test requests and accessed patients' personal and health data.

item.title: Wicker, with Olivia Colman, opens to $5.8 million in North America
item.description: The Sundance breakout starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård took $5.8 million in its first weekend.

item.title: Undead Labs is now employee-owned after leaving Xbox
item.description: The State of Decay studio turned down majority investors and signed with an unnamed publisher after Xbox divested it.

item.title: Arrowhead says Helldivers 3 is not in development
item.description: During Helldivers 2's Liberty Day event, Arrowhead's Johan Pilestedt said a third game is not being made.

item.title: Street Fighter slides to fourth with $8.6 million in week two
item.description: Paramount's Street Fighter fell steeply in its second weekend and has taken $79.6 million worldwide.
